items.label: Rustic Charm Design
items.value: Featuring a rustic aesthetic, this farmhouse console table brings cozy warmth to any entry space. The wood-grain finish and minimalist silhouette effortlessly complement decor styles from country cottage to contemporary

items.label: Sturdy Build
items.value: Engineered with premium MDF and reinforced by dual square legs, this long entryway table delivers reliable stability. It supports everyday essentials like table lamps, decorative bowls, or framed photos without wobbling

items.label: Ample Surface Area
items.value: With dimensions of 11.81" D x 63" W, the tabletop offers plenty of space for organizing and displaying your essentials. You can easily put a vase of flowers, a stack of magazines, or a tray for keys and mail on it

items.label: Versatile Placement
items.value: Not just for entryways, the modern hallway table can be placed in hallways, living rooms, or behind sofas. It serves as a side table or a display spot for artworks

items.label: Easy Installation & Effortless Care
items.value: This console table comes with clear instructions for a smooth setup. The smooth wooden surface is a breeze to clean; it just requires a quick wipe with a damp cloth to remove dust and stains to keep it beautiful

items.label: ***Tips
items.value: Colors may vary under different lighting conditions. Please refer to the actual product for the final color, and you can also check the color difference image and uploaded videos as references.
